description: Nesher c/n S-02 (ex IAF 12), to the FAA 28 December 1978, converted to Finger IIIA and renumbered C-411, retired 20 September 1998; trucked from Río Cuarto November 2017 and placed on its plinth 16 November 2023 in SEA camouflage in memory of 1st Lt Juan Bernhardt. Photographed 12 September 2025.
